title: In deliverResult of AppTimeTracker.java, there is a possible background activity launch due to a… (CVE-2026-58970)
description: CVE-2026-58970 is a high-severity vulnerability in the deliverResult method of AppTimeTracker.java that allows a possible background activity launch due to a confused deputy issue. This flaw can lead to local privilege escalation without requiring additional execution privileges or user interaction.
